visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a 2D animation on a black background. A yellow claw-machine crane descends and grabs an orange slime-like sphere from a pair of blue and orange slimes. A red slogan banner sits at the top. (2) Transition to a cartoon male character with short dark hair wearing a grey t-shirt. He points his finger upward while speaking against a soft gradient grey background. (3) The scene shifts to show various small items floating, including cookies and stars. Large yellow text '7 ± 2' appears centrally as part of a psychological explanation. (4) A memory test screen appears. It displays ten distinct icons: a set of keys, a cloud, a policeman, a teacher, a cookie, a backpack, a river, an umbrella, sushi, and trees. A magenta progress bar at the bottom acts as a 5-second timer. (5) The screen turns black with white text prompts, then returns to the male cartoon character who appears to be in a thinking pose with his hand on his chin. (6) The same ten icons are re-displayed, but this time they are grouped into four black rectangular boxes categorized by themes: items, nature, people, and food. The countdown bar repeats its depleting animation. (7) A white rounded mascot character with blue accents and the text '維C' on its chest appears, looking joyful and raising its arms. (8) A brief scene shows a character dressed in a white lab coat (scientist), followed by a comparison diagram of 'bits' (individual units) versus 'chunks' (grouped units) represented by underlined numbers. (9) The male character returns to summarize the lesson. The video concludes with a mind map diagram showing six connected nodes, followed by the white mascot appearing again with a lightbulb icon above its head.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: Only animated/cartoon characters present throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A cartoon male with short black hair and a grey t-shirt; a white rounded blob-like mascot with blue markings.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A variety of solid and gradient backgrounds including black, light blue, and grey. Technical diagrams and icon grids are used as thematic backgrounds for the memory tests.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a distinctive mechanical whirring sound followed by a wet 'boing' pop SFX as the claw machine operates. Upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM with a driving synth bassline enters immediately. (2) A clear, energetic male voice provides enthusiastic narration in Mandarin. Periodic 'ding' sound effects punctuate the appearance of visual text. (3) A sharp metronome ticking sound begins during the memory test phase, synchronized with the timer progress bar. BGM ducking occurs to emphasize the clock sound. (4) Narration resumes with a slightly higher pitch and teasing tone. A transient 'pop' SFX accompanies the scene change. (5) The metronome ticking sound returns for the second test sequence, maintaining a steady rhythmic pulse. (6) A high-pitched, chirpy cartoon mascot voice interjects with a short exclamation. (7) The male narrator's speech rate remains high as he explains psychological concepts, with technical synth pads in the background. (8) The BGM concludes with a bright, ascending electronic jingle and a final bell chime as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Challenge -> Scientific Explanation -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on Miller's Law—the idea that the average person can only hold about 7 items in their short-term memory—and demonstrates how 'chunking' or categorization can significantly improve memory recall.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: No products or services are endorsed; the content is purely educational.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The use of an interactive memory test directly engages the viewer's attention before providing the scientific theory, making it an effective educational piece for short-form social media.
